reading_guidance: Three near-duplicate variants intentionally retained inside each provisional family; they are parallel research wordings, not three final 12-bank slots.
The classifications and cross-family edges are editorial judgments without respondent data.
Character trigram lexical similarity is presented only as a triage signal. Low lexical overlap does not establish substantive uniqueness and vice versa.
Cross-axis overlap and false bipolar dichotomies should be checked before scoring.
No model or human semantic reviewer has validated the underlying psychometrics.
